about.text: It is made using the salty waters of the Almirón Hot Springs. Made with whole cow's milk. Presentation: cylindrical in shape, approximately 1 kg, 10 cm in diameter, and 8 cm high, smooth and clean surface. Color: slightly light yellow.

sources.text: Uruguayan cheese said to be brined in hot-spring water; unverified, no source found
